Sinha (1975) Mundari Grammar CIILP0091, Ramdayal Munda (2013) Mundari-Vyakaran BVP00202, and Mansidh Baraiud (2017) Nava Hodo Jagar Mundi BVP04856 were metadata-verified and their direct repository PDF cover manifestations visually inspected. Additional dictionary/book leads remain discovery or prior-known until deterministic register reconciliation.
parallel_search_notes.peer_reviewed_articles: Current and historical article sweep included the 2019 Language in Society Mundari expressives article and the 2026 FASAL Munda information-structure article; no article proposition was promoted without exact permitted passage-level processing.
parallel_search_notes.theses_dissertations: Pallavi Raonka's 2021 Virginia Tech dissertation and Walter A. Cook's 1965 Georgetown Mundari dissertation metadata were rechecked as relevant thesis/dissertation pathways; no duplicate identity/count was created and no ethnographic proposition was promoted in this cycle.
parallel_search_notes.government_tri_census_lsi: Official Census table infrastructure and the LSI Jharkhand Mundari pathway were rechecked. Indexed LSI search output exposes Mundari distribution-table content, but the direct official PDF again returned a gateway failure on open; no numeric Census/LSI claim was promoted without direct manifestation/page verification.
parallel_search_notes.archives: Bhasha Sanchika institutional archive and National Cultural Audiovisual Archives were searched alongside established DSAL/historical archive pathways. No archival cultural claim was promoted solely from catalogue discovery.
parallel_search_notes.newspapers_periodicals: News/periodical discovery sweep rerun; title-string or secondary-report matches were not promoted without stable primary article metadata and content support.
parallel_search_notes.web_resources: Government/institutional repository resources were prioritized. Bhasha Sanchika end-user terms were directly verified and used to constrain reuse; generic web summaries and title-string false positives were excluded from evidence promotion.
parallel_search_notes.datasets: Karya Mundari TTS and existing Rau/Lexibank/Grambank/MMLoSo pathways were rechecked. No dataset hash/count was upgraded without independently acquired exact bytes.
parallel_search_notes.audio: National Cultural Audiovisual Archives and existing Mundari audio pathways were searched; participant consent/community-validation/cultural-access gates remain distinct from platform availability or copyright licensing.
parallel_search_notes.video: Existing rights-supported Mundari/Munda video paths were retained; no participant identity or cultural proposition was newly exposed.
parallel_search_notes.maps: Official LSI/Census and Wikimedia linguistic-map pathways were rechecked; no map-derived demographic assertion was promoted without source/method verification.
parallel_search_notes.relevant_media: Broader media sweep retained only identity-supported Munda/Mundari-relevant resources; unrelated works carrying a similar title/string remain excluded.
